{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Buling |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Hi, I found a new ruin! You wanna go explore? Wait, wait. I'll post a thread on the forum first. Need a catchy title. How about, "A 50-year-old woman caught wandering in the ruin at midnight. Here's why." Or "What's the dark mist leaking from the city's most Yin spot?" Which one do you like better? Oh, don't forget to act scared later, okay? You can do it, I know. What happens next? Hehehe, first we get the clicks, then boom, we drop the truth. Even if the truth is boring. Come, come, I'll teach you some new forum slang first. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = The worse the danger, the better I focus and grow from it. Funny, huh? I haven't trained in my sect for a long time, and I usually avoid conflict and fighting. But whenever I face a Tacet Discord, in those dangerous places nobody dares to go... that's when my mind clears. No noise, just stillness. I get serious, channel my spirit, and really push my spells. This counts as cultivation training, right? |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = Peeking at heaven's secrets is the best fun! I'm curious about my fate, same as everyone else. But the rules say no reading your own fortune. Hmm... I don't believe heaven will punish me or take away blessings if I do. But knowing my fate will change how I live, and that will disrupt the Tao. So it's better I just let go and surprise myself with what comes next, right la? |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = Traveling around means I get to see all kinds of places. Each one has its own little joy, little magic. I always spend till my wallet is empty, then take a few jobs. One job, maybe two, then aiya, I spend all my money again! What to do? I'm really not that brave, you know. I've seen cities rise all shiny-shiny, and I've seen them burn to the ground. So I only dare to enjoy the now. Thinking too far ahead? Don't dare. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = First time seeing me without headphones? Hmm... I guess that's cause we usually met in safe places. Hehe, the headphones actually protect me. When I take them off, I'm either tracking the {{Extra Effect|Tacet Discords|Tacet Discord|Tacet Discords, beings created by the Waveworn Phenomena bearing "Tacet Cores", are dangerous entities with ever-changing, amorphous forms, which feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolution. These creatures mimic their prey's abilities, shapes, and behaviors, influenced by the types of frequency they consume.}}… or listening to you, like now. But wah, I talk too much already… now it's your turn, Boss. |vo_02_01_title = Buling's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = Playing games, of course! So many cool ones in {{Extra Effect|the Black Shores|The Black Shores|Solaris' foremost authority on observing the Lament cycle.
Through constant observation and analysis of Lament's shifting patterns, this organization predicts and warns of impending manifestations before they occur.}}. Want to co-op sometime? |vo_02_02_title = Buling's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = Been many years since I went back to my sect. Of course, it's not like I don't want to, but... what if Master tests my spells, or my kicks and punches? I... uh... I'm not scared to go back! I just haven't finished my training on the road. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Shredded fish noodles are a really tasty one! Put boiled noodles in the broth, then add shredded fish on top. Mmm, so good la! It's a Mengzhou specialty. You must give a bowl a try! |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = One bite of chili, and I start burning head to toe. My tummy also protests all day, all night. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = People call me "Spiritchaser Taoist" because they're afraid of the Tacet Discords and spooky unknowns. But the day Buling makes that name un-be-lingable… that means I did good. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = My friends from the Academy modded these headphones for me. They block out {{Extra Effect|Tacet Discord|Tacet Discord|Tacet Discords, beings created by the Waveworn Phenomena bearing "Tacet Cores", are dangerous entities with ever-changing, amorphous forms, which feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolution. These creatures mimic their prey's abilities, shapes, and behaviors, influenced by the types of frequency they consume.}} frequencies so I don't have all the noises in my head. I only take them off when there's a big job and I need to hear where the "ghosts" are hiding. But hey, don't think it's all silence in here! I've got music on right now. Wanna listen? It's Imaginary Foundry's new song, "To the sky—to the red tree—" |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = In this world, not only {{Extra Effect|Tacet Discords}} can kill. Fear can, too. And it's not only doctors who can save lives. Hope can, too. Sometimes, I say "There are no ghosts" to save people from fear. And sometimes, I say "Ghosts exist" to give people hope. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Jianxin]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Jianxin.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = She's the same as me, super good at some stuff, bad at others. Last martial contest, Master Shiling said she punches too much, thinks too little. I wanted to challenge her—but whoosh—her palm wind came out of nowhere and blew right through my spell array and talisman! But it's okay. I'm not the fist-and-muscle type. Redirecting force to attack is the smarter move. Hehe, knowing Jianxin's style, next time I might not even need to lift a finger. Just a bit of smooth talk and walk away with the win...? |vo_04_01_mention = Jianxin |vo_04_02_title = About [[Youhu]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Youhu.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = Master Youhu helps lots of my clients check their treasures, telling them what's real, what's fake, clearing their doubts and worries. But she's never that serious with me. Last time she brought out a new eggshell porcelain cup. Told me it's an ancient treasure with thin glaze, clean color, things like that, and she said five hundred {{Extra Effect|Shell Credits|Shell Credit|The universal currency issued by Huanglong, officially recognized across many regions.
In the ancient past, the ancestors of Huanglong utilized seashells as currency. Though the manufacturing techniques have evolved over time, the shell-like appearance of this currency has endured.}} is a steal. I said the cup was cursed with evil Yin Qi, and better pay seven hundred for a talisman seal, or it's not safe. Guess what happened in the end? |vo_04_02_mention = Youhu |vo_04_03_title = About [[Aalto]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Aalto.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = We haven't met many times, but somehow, he feels like an old friend. Why? I thought I knew many people from traveling, but he knows even more! No matter where I go, someone always drops his name. What's that theory… any two people in the world are only like, six degrees apart? I bet we show up in the same friend circles all the time. |vo_04_03_mention = Aalto |vo_04_04_title = About [[Camellya]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Camellya.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = She's... an interesting one. Before I joined {{Extra Effect|the Black Shores}}, she tried to fight me. Of course I was no match for her, so I ran for it, as fast as oil on shoes! But she chased me all the way... into the {{Extra Effect|Tacet Discord}} nest I led her to. She got caught up fighting, looked up and smiled at me. I was sitting in a tree, smiling right back. It was interesting... real interesting. |vo_04_04_mention = Camellya |vo_04_05_title = About [[Encore]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Encore.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = Every time I go chasing ghost rumors, I always ask Encore to come along. She's not scared and she loves a new adventure! Sometimes she even livestreams it on the forum, makes up spooky stories to reel our audience in. Then when we drop the twist there's no ghost, we hide behind the screen and laugh till our bellies hurt. Then? Poof. Delete account. Hey, you want to know our forum nicknames? I'm "Earthly Immortal," and she's "Heavenly Sheep." |vo_04_05_mention = Encore |vo_04_06_title = About [[Shorekeeper]] |vo_04_06_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_06_file = {character}{language} About Shorekeeper.ogg |vo_04_06_tx = She stands guard, outside all laws, all patterns... But total detatchment from the world isn't always a good thing. That isn't my divination, I can't read her. But I see it, loud and clear. |vo_04_06_mention = Shorekeeper |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Today's your birthday? Ooyo... your pillars of destiny, rare, rare! Hehe, I said before, you are the one to break the deadlock. Now I see the lock is probably more dead than we knew! Hmm? Aiya, don't stress. I mean rare in a good way. No better destiny than yours! So no worries, just believe in your path, and everything will go smoothly. Happy birthday, Boss! |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Let me check the feng shui here… hmm… oh? Ah... Ha! I knew it! |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = Someone commented on my post? Hmm? What?! Don't believe me? Ah, so stubborn... |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Hmm… the lost treasure is… somewhere around… ah! Now I write talisman guided from above. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = Between heaven and earth, true sounds ring clear. From now on, my spells will hit even harder! |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = Body and seal align, spirit gates open wide. My hand mudras now shift in a thousand forms. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = I walk the star steps, from Yin to Yang. The pulse of earth and the breath of heaven are now with me. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = After these enlightenments, I think I can now read more in you.
